app_fee.quote: An application processing fee of $80 charged through the application system.

fee_waiver.value: WCGS lists financial-hardship fee waivers with documentation including a letter from a U.S. Embassy/Consulate, EducationUSA, or U.S. government entity (or select pipeline programs), though the main application-process page limits waiver text to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, or undocumented applicants; fee waiver form opens Sept 1 and closes Nov 22, 2026.
fee_waiver.quote: PhD Application fee waivers are available to applicants who have demonstrated financial hardship or participated in specific pipeline programs described below. ... Letter sent directly from a U.S. Embassy or Consulate, EducationUSA, or other U.S. government agency/entity attesting to the applicant’s financial hardship.

also.quote: Application fee waivers are available to US citizens, permanent residents, or undocumented applicants who have demonstrated financial hardship or participated in specific pipeline programs.

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are optional for all Weill Cornell Graduate School PhD programs (ETS institution code 2119).
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are optional for all Weill Cornell PhD programs.

toefl_min.value: No minimum TOEFL score is set; WCGS accepts TOEFL (code 2119), IELTS, and DET and uses a holistic admissions review with no minimum test score.

also.quote: There is no minimum GPA or minimum test scores required to apply. WCGS embraces a holistic approach evaluating each application.
International applicants are required to provide proof of English language proficiency. Accepted Exams: Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) (WCGS ETS Code: #2119)

ielts_min.value: No minimum IELTS score is set; WCGS accepts IELTS, TOEFL, and DET and uses a holistic admissions review with no minimum test score.

also.quote: There is no minimum GPA or minimum test scores required to apply. WCGS embraces a holistic approach evaluating each application.

english_waiver.value: Standing exemption waives TOEFL/IELTS/DET for applicants who earned an international equivalent of a U.S. bachelor’s degree in an English-official country where English is the language of instruction (India is explicitly named; physical presence required for majority of enrollment).
english_waiver.quote: At the time of enrollment at Weill Cornell, will have earned the international equivalent of a U.S. bachelor’s degree from a college or university located in a country where English is an official language, and where English is the language of instruction (including but not limited to Ghana, Hong Kong, India, Nigeria, and Pakistan).

notes: Weill Cornell Graduate School of Medical Sciences (WCGS, Manhattan, NY; health-science scope): research covers biomed (Immunology & Microbial Pathogenesis, Pharmacology, Physiology/Biophysics/Systems Biology), neuro (Neuroscience), and biology (BCMB Allied Program); WCGS does not offer a Biomedical Engineering PhD (Cornell BME is on the Ithaca campus). Non-US transcripts require a NACES course-by-course evaluation (WES/TEC/IEE).
